from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# ============================================================
# 1. READ FROM DELTA
# ============================================================
STORAGE_ACCOUNT  = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER        = "mict"                          # ← Update for MFT
DELTA_MOVES_PATH = "silver/moves"
OUTPUT_PATH      = "gold/tranship_pairs"


BASE_PATH    = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net"
MOVES_PATH   = f"{BASE_PATH}/{DELTA_MOVES_PATH}"
OUTPUT_DELTA = f"{BASE_PATH}/{OUTPUT_PATH}"


df = spark.read.format("delta").load(MOVES_PATH)

# ============================================================
# 2. FILTER TRANSHIPMENT ONLY
# ============================================================
df_trshp = df.filter(
    (F.col("Category_Id") == "TRSHP") &
    (F.col("Event_Type_Id").isin("UNIT_DISCH", "UNIT_LOAD")) &
    (F.col("Year") >= 2026)
)

# ============================================================
# 3. EXTRACT YARDBLOCK FROM POSITION NAME
# Format: Y-MFT-XE 040 06B → XE
# ============================================================
SPECIAL_BLOCKS = [
    "BERTH1", "BERTH2", "BERTH3", "BERTH4", "BERTH5", "BERTH6", "BERTH7", "BERTH8",
    "CFS3", "NENACO", "OOG", "SW05", "SW34", "WALL", "XRAY",
]

def extract_yardblock(col_name):
    # 3rd segment: everything after the 2nd '-' up to the next '-' or space
    segment = F.regexp_extract(F.col(col_name), r"^Y-[^-]+-([^- ]+)", 1)
    return (
        F.when(~F.col(col_name).startswith("Y-"), F.lit(None))
         .when(segment == "", F.lit(None))
         .when(segment.isin(SPECIAL_BLOCKS), segment)   # BERTH6, OOG, SW34, ...
         .otherwise(segment.substr(1, 2))               # 5E0102F3 -> 5E
    )


df_trshp = df_trshp \
    .withColumn("From_YardBlock", extract_yardblock("From_Position_Name")) \
    .withColumn("To_YardBlock",   extract_yardblock("To_Position_Name"))

# ============================================================
# 4. CRANE LOOKUP
# ============================================================
cranes_data = [
    ('QC02','T1'),('QC03','T1'),('QC17','T1'),
    ('QC06','T1'),('QC07','T1'),('QC20','T1'),
    ('QC21','T1'),('QC08','T1'),('QC09','T1'),
    ('QC10','T1'),('QC18','T1'),('QC19','T1'),
    ('QC11','T2'),('QC12','T2'),('QC14','T2'),
    ('QC15','T2'),('QC16','T2'),('QC22','T2')
]
df_cranes = spark.createDataFrame(cranes_data, ["CraneId", "Crane_Terminal"])

# ============================================================
# 5. YARDBLOCK LOOKUP
# ============================================================
yardblocks_data = [
('0B', 'T1'), ('0C', 'T1'), ('0D', 'T1'), ('0E', 'T1'),('0F', 'T1'), ('0G', 'T1'), ('0H', 'T1'), ('0I', 'T1'),
('0J', 'T1'), ('0L', 'T2'), ('0M', 'T2'), ('0N', 'T2'),('0O', 'T2'), ('0P', 'T2'), ('1B', 'T1'), ('1C', 'T1'),
('1D', 'T1'), ('1E', 'T1'), ('1F', 'T1'), ('1G', 'T1'),('1H', 'T1'), ('1I', 'T1'), ('1J', 'T1'), ('1L', 'T2'),
('1M', 'T2'), ('1N', 'T2'), ('1O', 'T2'), ('1P', 'T2'),('1Q', 'T3'), ('2B', 'T1'), ('2C', 'T1'),('2D', 'T1'),
('2E', 'T1'), ('2F', 'T1'), ('2G', 'T1'),('2H', 'T1'), ('2I', 'T1'), ('2J', 'T1'), ('2K', 'T1'),('2L', 'T2'), 
('2M', 'T2'), ('2N', 'T2'), ('2O', 'T2'),('2P', 'T2'), ('2Q', 'T4'), ('3B', 'T1'),('3C', 'T1'), ('3D', 'T1'), 
('3E', 'T1'), ('3F', 'T1'),('3G', 'T1'), ('3H', 'T1'), ('3I', 'T1'), ('3J', 'T1'),('3K', 'T1'), ('3L', 'T2'),
('3M', 'T2'), ('3N', 'T2'),('3O', 'T2'), ('3P', 'T2'), ('3Q', 'T5'),('4B', 'T1'), ('4C', 'T1'), ('4D', 'T1'), ('4E', 'T1'),
('4F', 'T1'), ('4G', 'T1'), ('4H', 'T1'), ('4I', 'T1'),('4J', 'T1'), ('4K', 'T2'), ('4L', 'T2'), ('4M', 'T2'),
('4N', 'T2'), ('4O', 'T2'), ('4P', 'T2'),('5B', 'T1'), ('5C', 'T1'), ('5D', 'T1'), ('5E', 'T1'),
('5F', 'T1'), ('5G', 'T1'), ('5H', 'T1'), ('5I', 'T1'),('5J', 'T1'), ('5K', 'T2'), ('5L', 'T2'), ('5M', 'T2'),
('5N', 'T2'), ('5O', 'T2'), ('5P', 'T2'),('6B', 'T1'), ('6C', 'T1'), ('6D', 'T1'), ('6E', 'T1'),
('6F', 'T1'), ('6G', 'T1'), ('6H', 'T1'), ('6I', 'T1'),('6J', 'T1'), ('6K', 'T2'), ('6L', 'T2'), ('6M', 'T2'),
('6N', 'T2'), ('6O', 'T2'), ('6P', 'T2'),('7B', 'T1'), ('7C', 'T1'), ('7D', 'T1'), ('7E', 'T1'),
('7F', 'T1'), ('7G', 'T1'), ('7H', 'T1'), ('7I', 'T1'),('7J', 'T1'), ('7K', 'T1'), ('8B', 'T1'), ('8C', 'T1'),
('8D', 'T1'), ('8E', 'T1'), ('8F', 'T1'), ('8G', 'T1'),('8H', 'T1'), ('8I', 'T1'), ('8J', 'T1'), ('9E', 'T1'),
('9F', 'T1'), ('9G', 'T1'), ('9H', 'T1'), ('9I', 'T1'),('9J', 'T1'), ('BERTH1', 'T1'), ('BERTH2', 'T1'), ('BERTH3', 'T1'),
('BERTH4', 'T1'), ('BERTH5', 'T1'), ('BERTH6', 'T2'), ('BERTH7', 'T2'),('BERTH8', 'T2'), ('CB', 'T1'), ('CC', 'T1'), ('CD', 'T1'),
('CE', 'T1'), ('CF', 'T1'), ('CFS3', 'T1'), ('CG', 'T1'),('CH', 'T1'), ('CI', 'T1'), ('CJ', 'T1'), ('CK', 'T2'),
('CL', 'T2'), ('CM', 'T2'), ('CN', 'T2'), ('CO', 'T2'),('CP', 'T2'), ('NENACO', ''), ('OO', 'T2'), ('OOG', ''),
('SW05', ''), ('SW34', ''), ('WALL', ''), ('XF', 'T1'),('XG', 'T1'), ('XRAY', 'T1'), ('YF', 'T1'), ('YG', 'T1')
]
df_yardblocks = spark.createDataFrame(yardblocks_data, ["YardBlock", "TerminalShort"])
# ============================================================
# 6. JOIN TERMINAL LOOKUPS
# ============================================================
df_enriched = df_trshp \
    .join(df_cranes,    df_trshp.pow            == df_cranes.CraneId,      "left") \
    .join(df_yardblocks.alias("yf"), 
          df_trshp.From_YardBlock == F.col("yf.YardBlock"), "left") \
    .withColumnRenamed("TerminalShort", "From_Terminal") \
    .join(df_yardblocks.alias("yt"), 
          df_trshp.To_YardBlock   == F.col("yt.YardBlock"), "left") \
    .withColumnRenamed("TerminalShort", "To_Terminal")

# ============================================================
# 7. SEQUENCE MOVES PER UNIT
# ============================================================
window_seq = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("t_put")

df_sequenced = df_enriched.withColumn("move_seq", F.row_number().over(window_seq))

# ============================================================
# 8. SPLIT INTO DISCH AND LOAD
# ============================================================
df_disch = df_sequenced.filter(F.col("Event_Type_Id") == "UNIT_DISCH") \
    .select(
        "Unit_Nbr", "mve_gkey", "move_seq",
        "t_put", "Carrier_Visit_Key",
        "Crane_Terminal", "To_Terminal", "To_YardBlock",
        "Freight_Kind_Id", "pow"
    )

df_load = df_sequenced.filter(F.col("Event_Type_Id") == "UNIT_LOAD") \
    .select(
        "Unit_Nbr",
        F.col("mve_gkey").alias("load_mve_gkey"),
        F.col("move_seq").alias("load_move_seq"),
        F.col("t_put").alias("load_datetime"),
        F.col("Carrier_Visit_Key").alias("load_vessel"),
        F.col("Crane_Terminal").alias("load_crane_terminal"),
        F.col("From_Terminal").alias("load_yard_terminal"),
        F.col("From_YardBlock").alias("load_yard_block"),
        F.col("pow").alias("load_pow"),
        F.col("Carrier_Visit_Key").alias("load_Carrier_Visit_Key")
    )

# ============================================================
# 9. PAIR DISCH → NEXT LOAD
# LEFT JOIN to keep discharged units with no load yet (Pending)
# ============================================================
window_unit = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("move_seq")

# LEFT JOIN — keeps DISCH rows even with no matching LOAD
df_joined = df_disch.join(df_load, on="Unit_Nbr", how="left") \
    .filter(
        F.col("load_move_seq").isNull() |           # ← Pending Load (no load yet)
        (F.col("load_move_seq") > F.col("move_seq")) # ← Valid next load
    )

# Keep only the CLOSEST next load per discharge (Pending rows have no load so rank = 1)
window_closest = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr", "mve_gkey").orderBy(
    F.col("load_move_seq").asc_nulls_last()         # ← NULLs (Pending) go last in sort
)

df_paired = df_joined \
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(window_closest)) \
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1) \
    .drop("rn", "load_move_seq", "move_seq")

# ============================================================
# 10. ADD DERIVED COLUMNS
# ============================================================
window_tranship = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("t_put")

df_final = df_paired \
    .withColumn("dwell_hours",
        F.when(
            F.col("load_datetime").isNotNull(),
            # Completed transhipment — actual dwell
            (F.col("load_datetime").cast("long") -
             F.col("t_put").cast("long")) / 3600
        ).otherwise(
            # Pending load — dwell so far since discharge
            (F.unix_timestamp(F.current_timestamp()) -
             F.col("t_put").cast("long")) / 3600
        )
    ) \
    .withColumn("tranship_sequence",
        F.row_number().over(window_tranship)
    ) \
    .withColumn("tranship_type",
        F.when(
            F.col("load_mve_gkey").isNull(),
            F.lit("Pending Load")                           # No load yet
        ).when(
            (F.col("Crane_Terminal") == F.col("To_Terminal")) &
            (F.col("To_Terminal")  == F.col("load_yard_terminal"))  &
            (F.col("load_yard_terminal")   == F.col("load_crane_terminal")),
            F.lit("Same-Terminal")                          # All 4 legs on same terminal
        ).otherwise(
            F.lit("Cross-Terminal")                         # Any leg differs
        )
    
    ) \
    .withColumn("terminal_flow",
        F.when(
            F.col("load_mve_gkey").isNull(),
            F.concat(F.col("Crane_Terminal"), F.lit(" → Pending"))
        ).otherwise(
            F.concat(F.col("Crane_Terminal"), F.lit(" → "), F.col("load_crane_terminal"))
        )
    ) \
    .withColumn("disch_date",       F.to_date("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("load_date",        F.to_date("load_datetime")) \
    .withColumn("disch_year",       F.year("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("disch_month",      F.month("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("disch_month_name", F.date_format("t_put", "MMMM")) \
    .withColumn("disch_year_month", F.date_format("t_put", "yyyy-MM")) \
    .withColumnRenamed("t_put",             "disch_datetime") \
    .withColumnRenamed("Carrier_Visit_Key", "disch_vessel") \
    .withColumnRenamed("Crane_Terminal",    "disch_crane_terminal") \
    .withColumnRenamed("To_Terminal",       "disch_yard_terminal") \
    .withColumnRenamed("To_YardBlock",      "disch_yard_block")

# ============================================================
# 11. WRITE TO DELTA (silver layer)
# ============================================================
df_final.cache()

# Sanity check before writing
print(f"Total pairs:        {df_final.count()}")
print(f"Same-Terminal:      {df_final.filter(F.col('tranship_type') == 'Same-Terminal').count()}")
print(f"Cross-Terminal:     {df_final.filter(F.col('tranship_type') == 'Cross-Terminal').count()}")
print(f"Pending Load:       {df_final.filter(F.col('tranship_type') == 'Pending Load').count()}")

df_final.write \
    .format("delta") \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .save(OUTPUT_DELTA)

print("✅ tranship_pairs written successfully!")

df_final.unpersist()
